## Architecture Overview

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           MAIN THREAD                                 |
|  +-----------+  +-----------+  +-----------+  +-----------+           |
|  | Renderer  |  | Stores    |  | Controls  |  | Physics|           |
|  | (Three.js)|  | (Custom)  |  | (Input)   |  | (Facade)  |           |
|  +-----+-----+  +-----+-----+  +-----+-----+  +-----+-----+           |
|        |              |              |              |                 |
|        +--------------+--------------+--------------+                 |
|                               |                                        |
|                     +---------+---------+                              |
|                     | SharedArrayBuffers |                              |
|                     | (Lock-free comms)  |                              |
|                     +---------+---------+                              |
+-------------------------------|----------------------------------------+
                                |
+-------------------------------|----------------------------------------+
|                          PHYSICS WORKER                               |
|                     +---------+---------+                              |
|                     | Buffer-Backed     |                              |
|                     | Objects (BBO)     |                              |
|                     +---------+---------+                              |
|                               |                                        |
|  +-----------+  +----------------------------+  +-----------+          |
|  | Body Mgmt |  | Physics Loop (1.6ms step)  |  | Events    |          |
|  | (BVH/SAB) |<->|                          |<->| (Comlink) |          |
|  +-----------+  +----------------------------+  +-----------+          |
|                               |                                        |
|        +-----------+  +--------------+  +--------------+               |
|        | Collision |  | Dynamics     |  | Camera       |               |
|        | Detection |  | (Forces/Vel) |  | Controller   |               |
|        +-----------+  +--------------+  +--------------+               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

## Worker Communication Protocol

### Overview

Communication between the main thread and physics worker uses **SharedArrayBuffers** for lock-free, zero-copy data transfer. We use **Buffer-Backed Objects (BBO)** to provide typed property access over raw buffers.

### Shared Buffers

| Buffer Name          | Purpose                              | Direction       |
|---------------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------|
| `sharedDynamic`     | Dynamic body state (pos, quat, vel)  | Worker -> Main   |
| `tempSharedDynamic` | Pending main thread writes           | Main -> Worker   |
| `sharedKinematic`   | Kinematic body transforms            | Bidirectional   |
| `sharedPeerKinematic`| Multiplayer peer positions          | Main -> Worker   |
| `sharedStatic`      | Static body metadata                 | Worker -> Main   |
| `sharedCamera`      | Camera state and settings            | Bidirectional   |
| `sharedPhysic`      | Global physics state and timing      | Bidirectional   |
| `sharedZone`        | Trigger zone states                  | Worker -> Main   |
| `sharedInReach`     | Proximity trigger states             | Worker -> Main   |
| `sharedPointer`     | Mouse/pointer input                  | Main -> Worker   |
| `sharedCompanion`   | Companion/pet state                  | Worker -> Main   |
| `syncView`          | Atomics synchronization (Int32Array) | Bidirectional   |

### Sentinel Value Protocol

To detect when the main thread has written a value to `tempSharedDynamic`, we use **sentinel values**:

```javascript
// core/constants.js
export const SENTINEL_INT8 = 118;    // For Int8 properties
export const SENTINEL_FLOAT32 = 9876; // For Float32 properties
```

**Write Protocol (Main Thread):**
```javascript
// Main thread wants to set player position
tempSharedDynamic[0].positionx = 10;  // Write actual value
tempSharedDynamic[0].positiony = 5;
tempSharedDynamic[0].positionz = 0;
tempSharedDynamic[0].forcePosition = 1;  // Signal to worker (not sentinel)
```

**Read Protocol (Worker):**
```javascript
// Worker checks for pending writes
if (tempShared.positionx !== SENTINEL_FLOAT32) {
  shared.positionx = tempShared.positionx;
  tempShared.positionx = SENTINEL_FLOAT32;  // Reset to sentinel
}
```

### Timing and Synchronization

The physics loop uses two separate timers:

1. **Physics Write Timer** (20ms interval): Runs physics simulation and writes results
2. **Input Read Timer** (15ms interval): Reads main thread inputs more frequently

```
Time ----------------------------------------------------------->

Main Thread:
  | Input |     | Input |     | Input |     | Input |
  +-------+     +-------+     +-------+     +-------+

Worker:
  | Read | Physics | Write |   | Read | Physics | Write |
  +------+------+-------+     +------+------+-------+
          <--- 20ms interval --->
```

### Thread Synchronization (Atomics)

The physics engine uses `Atomics.wait/notify` for efficient thread synchronization instead of busy-waiting. This reduces CPU usage when waiting for the other thread.

#### Sync Buffer

A dedicated `Int32Array` sync buffer is used for Atomics operations:

```javascript
// core/sync.js
export const SyncFlag = {
  CALCULATING_SUBSTEP: 0,  // Worker is calculating a physics sub-step
  READING_INPUTS: 1,       // Worker is reading inputs from main thread
  FRONT_IS_READING: 2,     // Main thread is reading physics results
  PHYSIC_IS_WRITING: 3,    // Worker is writing physics results
  FRONT_WRITING_TEMP: 4,   // Main thread is writing to temp array
  PHYSIC_READING_TEMP: 5,  // Worker is reading from temp array
};
```

#### Synchronization Pattern

```javascript
// Worker waiting for main thread to finish
if (physicsState.syncView) {
  waitForUnlock(physicsState.syncView, SyncFlag.FRONT_WRITING_TEMP);
  acquireLock(physicsState.syncView, SyncFlag.PHYSIC_READING_TEMP);
}

// ... do work ...

if (physicsState.syncView) {
  releaseLock(physicsState.syncView, SyncFlag.PHYSIC_READING_TEMP);
}
```

#### How Atomics.wait Works

```javascript
// Atomics.wait blocks the thread efficiently (no CPU spinning)
// until another thread calls Atomics.notify or timeout is reached
function waitForUnlock(syncView, flagIndex, timeout = 500) {
  if (Atomics.load(syncView, flagIndex) === UNLOCKED) {
    return 'not-equal';  // Already unlocked
  }
  return Atomics.wait(syncView, flagIndex, LOCKED, timeout);
}

function releaseLock(syncView, flagIndex) {
  Atomics.store(syncView, flagIndex, UNLOCKED);
  Atomics.notify(syncView, flagIndex, 1);  // Wake waiting thread
}
```

#### Legacy Fallback

For backwards compatibility, the code falls back to busy-waiting if `syncView` is not available:

```javascript
if (physicsState.syncView) {
  // Use efficient Atomics.wait
  waitForUnlock(physicsState.syncView, SyncFlag.FRONT_IS_READING);
} else if (physicsState.sharedPhysic.frontIsReading) {
  // Legacy busy-wait fallback
  const startTime = performance.now();
  while (physicsState.sharedPhysic.frontIsReading) {
    if (performance.now() - startTime > LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS) break;
  }
}
```

**Synchronization Flags:**
- `CALCULATING_SUBSTEP`: Worker is in the middle of a physics sub-step
- `READING_INPUTS`: Worker is reading main thread inputs
- `FRONT_IS_READING`: Main thread is reading shared buffers
- `PHYSIC_IS_WRITING`: Worker is writing to shared buffers
- `FRONT_WRITING_TEMP`: Main thread is writing to temp buffer
- `PHYSIC_READING_TEMP`: Worker is reading temp buffer

## SharedArrayBuffer Data Structures

### Dynamic Body Schema

```javascript
{
  used: Int8,              // 1 = active, 0 = free slot

  // Current transform
  positionx: Float64,
  positiony: Float64,
  positionz: Float64,
  quaternionx: Float32,
  quaterniony: Float32,
  quaternionz: Float32,
  quaternionw: Float32,

  // Previous transform (for interpolation)
  prevPositionx: Float64,
  prevPositiony: Float64,
  prevPositionz: Float64,
  prevQuaternionx: Float32,
  prevQuaterniony: Float32,
  prevQuaternionz: Float32,
  prevQuaternionw: Float32,

  // Velocity
  localVelocityx: Float32,
  localVelocityy: Float32,
  localVelocityz: Float32,
  externalVelocityx: Float32,
  externalVelocityy: Float32,
  externalVelocityz: Float32,

  // Forces
  forcex: Float32,
  forcey: Float32,
  forcez: Float32,

  // Physics properties
  friction: Float32,
  mass: Float32,
  maxVelocity: Int16,
  forceCapacity: Float32,
  turnCapacity: Float32,

  // State flags
  colliding: Int8,
  falling: Int8,
  ground: Int8,
  sleep: Int8,
  move: Int8,
  moving: Int8,
  jumping: Int8,
  // ... more flags
}
```

### Camera Schema

```javascript
{
  used: Int8,

  // Transform
  positionx: Float64,
  positiony: Float64,
  positionz: Float64,
  quaternionx: Float32,
  quaterniony: Float32,
  quaternionz: Float32,
  quaternionw: Float32,

  // Offsets
  targetOffsetx: Float32,
  targetOffsety: Float32,
  targetOffsetz: Float32,
  cameraOffsetx: Float32,
  cameraOffsety: Float32,
  cameraOffsetz: Float32,

  // Drag/rotation
  dragDeltax: Float32,
  dragDeltay: Float32,
  absoluteDeltax: Float32,
  absoluteDeltay: Float32,

  // Mode flags
  firstPerson: Int8,
  birdView: Int8,
  lockRotation: Int8,
  dialogMode: Int8,
  aimMode: Int8,
  // ... more flags
}
```

## Physics Loop

### Fixed Timestep with Accumulator

```javascript
const FIXED_TIMESTEP = 0.0016;  // 1.6ms
const FIXED_TIMESTEP_MS = 1.6;

function step(callback, counter) {
  const now = performance.now();
  const delta = now - lastTime;
  lastTime = now;

  accumulator += delta;
  accumulator = Math.min(accumulator, FIXED_TIMESTEP_MS * 2);

  while (accumulator >= FIXED_TIMESTEP_MS) {
    // Pre-step: Process input, calculate forces
    preStep(body, FIXED_TIMESTEP, sharedDynamic);

    // Apply kinematic transforms
    updateKinematic(bodies.kinematic);

    // Dynamics: Apply forces, gravity, friction
    dynamic(body, FIXED_TIMESTEP, sharedDynamic);

    // Collision detection and response
    trimeshCollide(body, sharedDynamic);
    trimeshSolver(body, sharedDynamic);

    // Post-step: Update state flags
    postStep(body, sharedDynamic);

    // Camera update
    thirdPerson(body, FIXED_TIMESTEP, sharedDynamic);

    accumulator -= FIXED_TIMESTEP_MS;
  }

  // Write results to shared buffer
  finishFrame(body, sharedDynamic, tempSharedDynamic);
}
```

## Body Types

### Dynamic Bodies
- Full physics simulation (gravity, forces, collision response)
- Capsule collider shape
- Controlled by player input or AI

### Kinematic Bodies
- Scripted/animated movement
- Can push dynamic bodies
- Hierarchical parent-child relationships
- Optional `managerFunc` for custom animation

### Static Bodies
- Immovable world geometry
- Organized into spatial grid cells for broad-phase culling
- Large bodies stored in separate "large" group

### Zones
- Trigger volumes (no collision response)
- Enter/exit callbacks
- Box or sphere shapes

## Collision Detection

### Pipeline

```
1. Broad Phase (Spatial Grid)
   - Filter bodies by grid cell

2. Narrow Phase (BVH Shapecast)
   - Capsule vs Triangle mesh

3. Collision Response
   - Position correction + velocity reflection
```

### Capsule-Trimesh Collision

```javascript
// Expand capsule segment by radius to get AABB
tempSegment.copy(capsuleInfo.segment);
tempSegment.applyMatrix4(transformer.matrix);
tempBox.expandByPoint(tempSegment.start);
tempBox.expandByPoint(tempSegment.end);
tempBox.min.addScalar(-capsuleInfo.radius);
tempBox.max.addScalar(capsuleInfo.radius);

// BVH shapecast
bvh.shapecast({
  intersectsBounds: (box) => box.intersectsBox(tempBox),
  intersectsTriangle: (tri) => {
    const distance = tri.closestPointToSegment(tempSegment, triPoint, capsulePoint);
    if (distance < capsuleInfo.radius) {
      // Calculate penetration depth and direction
      const depth = capsuleInfo.radius - distance;
      direction.subVectors(capsulePoint, triPoint).normalize();
      deltaPosition.addScaledVector(direction, depth);
    }
  }
});
```

## Camera System

### Modes

| Mode | Description | Rotation | Model |
|------|-------------|----------|-------|
| `THIRD_PERSON` | Classic third-person | Locked to character | Visible |
| `THIRD_PERSON_FREE` | Orbiting camera | Free rotation | Visible |
| `FIRST_PERSON` | Inside character head | Locked | Hidden |
| `BIRD_VIEW` | Top-down perspective | Free | Visible |

### Camera Collision

Camera uses raycasting to prevent clipping through geometry:
1. Cast ray from target to camera position
2. If hit, move camera closer to target
3. In dithering mode, rotate ray origin in circle for smoother transitions

## Code Conventions

### File Organization

```
src/
- core/                 # Core utilities and constants
  - constants.js        # Magic numbers and config
  - Physics.js       # Main facade class
  - SharedBuffers.js    # BBO schema definitions
- physics/              # Physics simulation
  - preStep.js          # Input processing
  - dynamic.js          # Force/velocity integration
  - postStep.js         # State updates
  - trimesh/            # Collision detection
- camera/               # Camera controllers
- store/                # State management
- workers/              # Web Worker modules
- helpers/              # Utility functions
```

### Import Order

```javascript
// 1. External dependencies
import * as THREE from 'three/webgpu';
import { MeshBVH } from 'three-mesh-bvh';

// 2. Internal core modules
import { FIXED_TIMESTEP, BodyType } from '../core/constants.js';
import { physicsState } from '../store/physicsState.js';

// 3. Physics modules
import { trimeshCollide } from './trimesh/trimeshCollide.js';

// 4. Helpers
import { createCapsuleInfo } from '../helpers/capsule.js';
```

## Naming Conventions

### Variables

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Constants | SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE | `FIXED_TIMESTEP` |
| Module-level temp objects | camelCase with `_` prefix for reused | `const _tempVec3 = new Vector3()` |
| Function parameters | camelCase | `deltaTime`, `bodyIndex` |
| Boolean flags | is/has/can prefix | `isGrounded`, `hasCollision` |

### Functions

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Pure computation | verb + noun | `computeGravityForce()` |
| State mutation | set/update prefix | `updateVelocity()` |
| Event handlers | on prefix | `onCollisionEnter()` |
| Factory functions | create prefix | `createDynamicBody()` |

### Shared Buffer Properties

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Position components | propertyname + x/y/z | `positionx`, `positiony` |
| Quaternion components | propertyname + x/y/z/w | `quaternionw` |
| Boolean flags | lowercase, no prefix | `ground`, `jumping`, `sleep` |
| Previous frame values | prev + Property | `prevPositionx` |

### Body/API Naming

```javascript
// Worker-side body object
const body = {
  bvh: Mesh,              // BVH collision mesh
  transformer: Object3D,   // Transform container
  prevTransformer: Object3D,
  capsuleInfo: {...},     // Collision shape
  // ...
};

// Shared buffer view (abbreviated)
const sDynamic = sharedDynamic[bodyIndex];

// API object (main thread facing)
const api = {
  localVelocity: Vector3,
  externalVelocity: Vector3,
  colliding: boolean,
  // ...
};
```

### Event Names

```
{bodyType}_{eventType}_{bodyIndex}

Examples:
- static_collide_0
- kinematic_mouseOver_5
- zone_enter_12
```

## Debug Mode

Enable debug mode by setting `sharedPhysic.debug = true`. This exposes:
- Raycast visualization data
- Collision point markers
- Performance timing

```javascript
// Check debug flag before expensive operations
if (__DEV__ && sharedPhysic.debug) {
  sharedPhysic.gravityRaycasterOriginx = raycaster.ray.origin.x;
  // ...
}
```

Use build-time `__DEV__` flag to strip debug code in production.
